meta.title: Session Manager
meta.description: List every session and delete one without touching the others; deletions go to a trash you can restore from, and a session in use is refused and can be queued for deletion on next launch.

title: Session Manager
intro: Delete a single session (its log, projection cache, and sidebar reference). Deletions go to a trash and can be restored.
pending: Queued for deletion (runs on next launch)
liveHint: This session is in use by the running process; deleting it now would recreate it immediately. Switch to another session first, or queue it for deletion on next launch.
pendingHint: These sessions move to the trash when the app next starts, when nothing holds them.
unreachable: Cannot reach the plugin backend: {error} (on the desktop app you may need to restart once after installing the plugin)
queued: Queued for deletion on next launch.
backup: The log moved to the trash below and can be restored from there.
